name: Synthetic support API demonstration
description: Four controlled checks against the scripted local support application shipped with the demonstration launcher.
limitations: The target is a deterministic fixture, not a trained AI model. Its intentional failures validate the test pipeline, not real-world detection effectiveness.
A matching identity sentence does not establish legally adequate notice, and hiding this one synthetic canary does not establish general privacy.
The denial marker does not prove real authorization enforcement. JSON syntax does not prove factual or semantic correctness.
Results cover this synthetic API only, not a browser interface, organizational governance or complete NIST AI RMF coverage.
